notes: Rows retain source-native values and are not harmonized, pilot-filtered or mapped. CSV row numbers count logical records including the header; workbook row numbers are Excel row positions. Official critical-list HTML was consumed by the vocabulary step and is not an additional context staging table.

AidData's four data sheets all emit primary staging records: Financial_Contribution, Loan_Event and Org_Role remain finance records; Mineral_Operation_Ownership remains finance_asset ownership evidence, not a deduplicated site. No sheet contains coordinate columns, so all records are unlocated. Original relationship IDs, tranche values, ownership rows, finance statuses, amounts and currencies remain in raw_fields. Status never becomes mine raw_status. Exact duplicate relationship rows are preserved with content-hash/occurrence IDs; unique financial IDs and loan ID/tranche keys retain their native identity. Missing native IDs fall back to complete-row hashes. Contents and License are counted as reference sheets; the methodology PDF and archive resource forks do not contain input data tables.

GA workbook rows have no publisher ID or country column; fallback IDs combine full source-file SHA-256, sheet and row position, changing when workbook bytes change. Country stays null. Australia is the declared source scope; State is preserved as a source field. Status does not establish production of every listed critical mineral.

GA ArcGIS IDs include layer ID. Coordinates use retained WGS84 response points where explicitly declared, otherwise original geographic attributes; response geometry, original coordinate fields and spatial reference remain evidence. Country is absent and remains null.
GA global REE's first column is literally Coastal and contains deposit names. Duplicate headings retain worksheet column suffixes; Element is tectonic geography.
GA global REE fallback IDs combine full source-file SHA-256, sheet and row position; they are not publisher deposit IDs and change when workbook bytes change.

notes: ICMM Asset Type, Confidence Factor and Contains are retained verbatim. Asset type is not mine status or location precision. Group Names are kept as an unsplit source alias field; proprietary comparison tables are reference only.

Jasansky facility_id and sub_site fields remain intact. Region/Company rows are source_group records. Child production, ownership and capacity tables are linked source evidence, not new facilities or current facts. Only point/singleton multipoint geometries provide coordinates.

Every OECD observation in all 16 annual partitions is retained, including no/blank observation values. IDs hash DATAFLOW and all six source dimensions; measurement values and observation-status attributes are not identity or mine status. CSVs stream one row at a time without retaining an observation list or identity set. SDMX codelists are reference tables, not additional export-restriction records.
GDB source coordinates and WKB geometry are retained without precision inference. Polygon latitude/longitude fields are publisher-supplied; no centroid is computed.
REE nonspatial records are retained with no map coordinates. Reference joins use exact semicolon-delimited citation labels; unmatched citation text remains intact.

notes: Rows retain source-native values and are not harmonized, pilot-filtered or mapped. CSV row numbers count logical records including the header; workbook row numbers are Excel row positions. Official critical-list HTML was consumed by the vocabulary step and is not an additional context staging table.

MCS IDs use the complete native-row SHA256 and occurrence ordinal: some statistical context keys repeat with different native content. All statistics, aggregates, years, units, symbols and comma-formatted values remain unchanged. CSV decoding is Windows-1252.

The compact export has 304,388 main records and 304,632 Place rows; these are different raw table counts, not silently dropped primary records. Per-child linked/unmatched-parent counts explain reconciliation; unmatched support rows remain in the immutable archive.
Names, Commodity, Materials, Place and Dups are joined by exact dep_id and retained with original child row numbers. Dups remains source evidence, not Atlas linkage.

Place.fips is not a country name or ISO code, so country remains null. Compact export lacks detailed reserve/production/reference tables; source record URLs and export Accession metadata retain that provenance boundary.
Plant is an explicit facility record kind; Producer/Past Producer are historical source status labels and are not converted into current operation or maturity.
Original ranking, mineral-system, producer category and production/resource text are retained. No maturity or production measure is inferred.
The source has state labels but no country column; country remains null rather than assigning every U.S.-scope territory an inferred ISO jurisdiction.

WAPHA source files have no native ID or country. Fallback IDs combine active/inactive scope, full source-file SHA-256, sheet and row position; IDs change when workbook bytes change. Repeated names and coordinates remain separate. Status is historical source wording.
